slides.title:
The base gets made
here, not bought.
slides.body:
M+MS stands for Malt plus Mixology. Most bars buy their spirits and build outward from the bottle; this one runs a brewery and a fermentation programme in-house, so the starting material — beer, koji, fermented fruit, brine — is made in the same building.

The World's 50 Best describes the room, run by JJ Lim and Louis Eom, less as a bar than a cultural space: a fermentation collective that opens as a cafe in the afternoon and turns to the cocktail list in the evening. There is a kitchen too, listing gochujang ragu pasta, lobster rolls and miso beef tartare.

items.t: Come for the fermentation, not the classics
items.d: The published menu leans experimental — kimchi broth, koji, house beer as a cocktail base

caption:
A bar that makes its own base ingredients, then serves them from 2pm.

M+MS — Malt plus Mixology — is a new entry at No. 42 on Asia's 50 Best Bars 2026, in Gangnam. It brews beer on site and ferments in-house: one drink starts from sour kimchi broth, another from koji and house-fermented pear.

Hours differ between listings, so confirm first.

Sources in the last slide. Save it for your next trip.
